name: Reward Of Saints The
overview: Scripture reveals that the reward of the saints is a glorious and eternal inheritance characterized by joy, satisfaction, and the presence of God. The psalmist expresses confidence in beholding God's face and receiving guidance that leads to glory and fullness of joy (Psalms 16:11; 17:15; 73:24). The righteous are assured of a sure reward for their faithfulness (Proverbs 11:18), and the Lord promises to conquer death and wipe away all tears, bringing salvation and rejoicing to His people (Isaiah 25:8-9). These truths highlight the blessed hope and eternal joy reserved for those who endure and serve Christ faithfully.
